items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: the rhythm section in those days, the first call rhythm section was Milt Hinton, Osie Johnson and Hank Jones.

ctx.x: I came to New York in February of ’62 and I got kind of active in the studio work, it wasn’t very long after that, maybe ’63. It took me about a year to get ingrained in the thing. And the rhythm section in those days, the first call rhythm section was Milt Hinton, Osie Johnson and Hank Jones. I mean I’m not saying they did everything but that was pretty much THE rhythm section. But in those days everything in the studios, whether it be a jingle or a recording, all was based on swing music. I mean the only time…
